learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn about different coins and notes, and how to use money to buy fun things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Money comes in round metal coins and colorful paper notes. We have coins for 1 Rupee, 2 Rupees, 5 Rupees, and 10 Rupees!
When we want a toy or a candy from a shop, we have to look at its price. Then we give the shopkeeper the exact amount of money.
If an eraser costs 3 Rupees, we can give a 2-Rupee coin and a 1-Rupee coin. We just add them up! 2 plus 1 makes 3!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Toy Shop
fun_activity.instructions: Put price tags on your toys (like ₹5, ₹10). Ask your friends to buy them using real coins or fake paper money!

quick_recap: ⭐ We use money in the form of notes and coins to buy things.
⭐ Every object in a shop has a price tag that tells us its value.
⭐ We can add smaller coins together to make a bigger amount.
